name: Graham Bread (Unfermented)
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder
ingredients.originalText: three heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder

instructions.text: Stir together three heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder, three cups of Graham flour and one cup of white flour
add a large teaspoonful of salt and half a cup of sugar
Mix all thoroughly with milk or water into as stiff a batter as can be stirred with a spoon
If water is used, a lump of butter as large as a walnut may be melted and stirred into it

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Stir together three heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder, three cups of Graham flour and one cup of white flour
2. add a large teaspoonful of salt and half a cup of sugar
3. Mix all thoroughly with milk or water into as stiff a batter as can be stirred with a spoon
4. If water is used, a lump of butter as large as a walnut may be melted and stirred into it
5. Bake immediately in well-greased pans
